changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names and model names. Added 'Speech Understanding' task since the paper evaluates speech-to-text and emotion classification capabilities. Added more specific output descriptions based on the different evaluation tasks.
Removed duplicate entries and abbreviations, keeping only the full metric names. Normalized GPTScore to GPT-Score for consistency.

No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - all evaluations used automatic metrics or LLM-as-judge.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on security evaluation of Speech Language Models (SLMs) against jailbreak attacks. While it evaluates NLG tasks (dialogue generation, speech understanding), the primary contribution is in adversarial robustness rather than NLG quality evaluation per se. The paper uses automatic metrics extensively and employs GPT-4 as a judge via GPTScore, but does not conduct human evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and consolidation of duplicate entries.
